summary: Paul Singer founded the activist hedge fund Elliott Management in 1977 and is one of the largest Republican donors. He was among Marco Rubio's top backers in the 2016 primary, supported Nikki Haley early in 2024, and later gave to Republican congressional super PACs and Trump's MAGA Inc.
